name: Pembrolizumab + Platinum/Paclitaxel +/- Bevacizumab for PD-L1-positive Recurrent/Metastatic Cervical Cancer (KEYNOTE-826)
histology: cervical squamous cell carcinoma, adenocarcinoma, or adenosquamous carcinoma

biomarkers.note: Biomarker gated: pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy (with or without bevacizumab) is indicated for persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer whose tumors express PD-L1 with a combined positive score (CPS) >= 1, as determined by an FDA-approved test (DeVita 12th ed. line 171423; NCCN CERV-F footnote j: recommended when tumors express PD-L1 CPS >= 1).

lineOfTherapy: first-line systemic therapy for persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer with PD-L1 CPS >= 1

eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
eligibilityCriteria.locator: line 171423 (FDA approved pembrolizumab with chemotherapy +/- bevacizumab for PD-L1 CPS >= 1); NCCN CERV-F footnote j

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical carcinoma
eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
eligibilityCriteria.locator: lines 171409 to 171423 (phase 3 RCT of pembrolizumab plus platinum-based chemotherapy +/- bevacizumab)

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 171411 (pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks for up to 35 cycles plus platinum-based chemotherapy and, per investigator discretion, bevacizumab)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 171411 (KEYNOTE-826). Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV on day 1, every 3 weeks (21 days) for up to 35 cycles. Immune-related adverse-event monitoring required. A subcutaneous pembrolizumab coformulation is an alternative with different dosing per NCCN CERV-F footnote k.

drugs.name: CARBOplatin or CISplatin

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 171411 to 171412 (plus platinum-based chemotherapy); per-drug platinum dose not printed

drugs.notes: Platinum backbone (carboplatin or cisplatin) per KEYNOTE-826 / NCCN CERV-F (Cisplatin/Paclitaxel + Pembrolizumab or Carboplatin/Paclitaxel + Pembrolizumab). The cited sources state platinum-based chemotherapy but do NOT print the platinum dose, basis, unit, or schedule; all VERIFY. Cisplatin requires hydration and nephro/oto/neuro monitoring. Tall man per ISMP for CISplatin/CARBOplatin.

drugs.name: PACLitaxel

provenance.locator: CERV-F 1 of 4 (Cisplatin/Paclitaxel + Pembrolizumab; Carboplatin/Paclitaxel + Pembrolizumab, category 1); per-drug dose not printed

drugs.notes: PACLitaxel is the taxane component of the KEYNOTE-826 backbone. Sources name the regimen but do NOT print the paclitaxel dose/schedule; basis, dosePerUnit, unit, and days are VERIFY. Corticosteroid plus H1/H2 antihistamine premedication per labeling. Tall man per ISMP.

drugs.name: Bevacizumab

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 171412 (bevacizumab per investigator discretion); NCCN CERV-F +/- Bevacizumab; per-drug dose not printed

drugs.notes: OPTIONAL bevacizumab (per investigator discretion / +/- per NCCN CERV-F). The cited sources do NOT print the bevacizumab dose/schedule; basis, dosePerUnit, unit, and days are VERIFY. No dose cap. Blood-pressure and proteinuria surveillance; fistula/VTE/bleeding precautions. Omit this drug entirely when bevacizumab is not used.

regimen.cycles: pembrolizumab 200 mg every 21 days for up to 35 cycles (DeVita line 171411); the platinum/paclitaxel backbone cycle count is not printed in the cited sources (VERIFY)

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid plus H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling.

premedications.name: Cisplatin hydration (if cisplatin used)
premedications.notes: IV hydration before and after cisplatin.

supportiveCare: immune-related adverse-event monitoring for pembrolizumab (thyroid, hepatic, pulmonary, colitis, endocrinopathies).
bevacizumab (if used): hypertension and proteinuria surveillance; fistula, VTE, and bleeding precautions.

monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol as indicated) during pembrolizumab
renal function (creatinine, electrolytes/Mg) if cisplatin used
blood pressure and urine protein if bevacizumab used

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse-event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 171409 to 171423 (KEYNOTE-826 phase 3 RCT: pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks up to 35 cycles + platinum-based chemotherapy +/- bevacizumab; PFS/OS benefit in PD-L1 CPS >= 1; FDA approval Oct 2021 for PD-L1 CPS >= 1)

guideline.locator: Systemic Therapy for Cervical Cancer, Recurrent/Metastatic First-Line, PD-L1-positive: Cisplatin/Paclitaxel + Pembrolizumab and Carboplatin/Paclitaxel + Pembrolizumab, +/- Bevacizumab (category 1) (CERV-F 1 of 4); footnote j (PD-L1 CPS >= 1)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for the KEYNOTE-826 regimen (pembrolizumab plus platinum/paclitaxel, with or without bevacizumab) for PD-L1-positive persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer (StewardMD reference disease cervical_cancer, subtype #42). Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 21 days for up to 35 cycles is grounded to DeVita 12th ed. line 171411, and the PD-L1 CPS >= 1 biomarker gate to DeVita line 171423 (FDA approval) and NCCN CERV-F footnote j. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Cervical Cancer v2.2026 (CERV-F) lists Cisplatin/Paclitaxel + Pembrolizumab and Carboplatin/Paclitaxel + Pembrolizumab (+/- Bevacizumab, category 1) but does NOT print the platinum, paclitaxel, or bevacizumab per-drug doses; those dose/basis/unit/day fields and the backbone cycle count are set to VERIFY and listed in verifyFields, pending a dosing source. No dose was invented or inferred. Bevacizumab is optional (omit the drug when not used) and has no dose cap; pembrolizumab requires immune-related adverse-event monitoring. ISMP tall man applied (CISplatin, CARBOplatin, PACLitaxel). This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
